name: elf-b-de-en-l0
skip: Contract-only in CI because GitHub ELF checkpoint artifacts are not bundled; local trtmc run supports prompt-conditioned sampling when the bundle includes the official JAX T5 encoder plan, or raw replay when condition latents and mask are supplied.

inputs.condition_api: prompt-conditioned runs may pass --prompt/--source_text when the bundle includes elf_text_encoder_plan; replay runs may instead provide condition_latents_raw/condition_latents_path and condition_mask_raw/condition_mask_path
inputs.output_schema: jsonl lines with id, generated, and token_ids

metadata.expected_report: Conditional ELF evaluation reports generated translations and BLEU/ROUGE-style task metrics when online evaluation is enabled.
metadata.notes: Represents the user-visible ELF conditional translation contract: encode the source prompt with the bundled official JAX T5 encoder plan or accept precomputed source-condition latents through the raw API path, generate English target embeddings with the ELF flow, decode final logits, and emit generated translation text with token_ids.
